title: Mean of the conjunction of two signs
statement: Choose signs $a,b\in\{−1,1\}$ independently and uniformly, and let their conjunction be $-1$ exactly when both signs are $-1$, and $1$ otherwise. The expected real value of this conjunction is $1/2$.
